## Review: ACCEPT · PR #23304 (draft, head `82522ac6a8`, `Fixes #23294`) · `domain:devx` seat 1 · `session_012zwsLMxQBwHUYJgPyrpEvx` · 2026-10-13T17:05Z

I checked this on GitHub, not just in the dev's report.

- **Shape**
  - Two files, both on the claimed surface: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (+41) and its self-test (+88). There are no deletions.
  - `examples/app-showcase/types/node-shim.d.ts` and `.github/workflows/**` are untouched, which is the card's ban.
  - **Not governed.** I read `GOVERNED_SURFACES` in `check-governed-merges.mjs` on `main`. It has rows for `docs/adr/`, `.claude/`, `skills/`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` and `.github/workflows/`, and no row for `scripts/pm/`. Running `dispatch-gates --tier` on the file gives "no path-derived mandate". So the "governed" remark in triage `6148727663` does not hold, and triage has since routed the card back to this lane (`6150711180`).
  - It touches no contract face, so the seat's review is the right one.
  - Labels: `size/m`, `skip-changeset`. The change is PM tooling and ships in no package.
- **The fix reads correctly**
  - `SCRATCH_CALL`, the resolver and the verdict are unchanged. Two rules are added.
  - First rule: `DECLARATION_FILE = /\.d\.[cm]?ts$/` returns zero sites for a whole declaration file. An ambient context admits no statements, so nothing in such a file can run.
  - Second rule: a match is skipped only when the masked text directly before it ends in `function` plus whitespace. This is the same test `singleCallSiteParameters` already applies.
  - The keyword rule is narrow. It is anchored at the end of the slice, and comments and string literals are masked before it runs. A real call is never preceded by the bare `function` keyword. Shapes it does not clear, such as `function*` or an interface method in a `.ts` file, stay UNRESOLVED, so they fail loudly.
- **Pins and controls**
  - Six fast-tier cases. Each of the two rules is pinned on a fixture that only that rule can clear.
  - Three controls: a real `mkdtempSync(someUnreadableBase)` call is still UNRESOLVED when it stands alone, when it sits beside a declaration of the same name, and when it sits inside the body of a wrapper with the same name.
  - Three ablations: removing the file rule fails case 2; removing the keyword rule fails cases 3, 5 and 6; making the keyword rule match everything fails exactly the three controls. After each, the tree was restored to HEAD.
- **Measured against the base**
  - Full battery at `bae5841bce`: 1 of 2093 failed, and it was the card's case word for word. At head: 2099 of 2099 pass.
  - Site lists: 1764 raw matches before and after. In-tree sites stay at 63, exposed sites stay at 0, and unresolved sites go from 315 to 313. The diff is exactly the shim's two declaration lines, `:26 mkdirSync` and `:30 mkdtempSync`.
  - Derived gates: 29 derived, 29 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- **CI on `82522ac6a8`**
  - 21 green, 11 skipped, none red. Four are still running, among them `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (`115427194058`), which is the fast tier carrying the six new cases.
  - The PR goes ready and auto-merge is armed. The queue merges only on green.
- **The pin is still owed after landing.** The live-tree case runs only on push and in the hourly full battery. #23274 closes on the first green hourly `Lint & Type Check` after the merge, and this seat records it.
- **Out of scope, kept on record**
  - `ci-failure.mjs --run 38411694784` prints "NONE of its members was found". It probably groups same-name check-runs across runs, so a later cancelled row hides the red member. I noted this on #23274 myself (`6148507314`). It is filed as a follow-up card in the same act.
  - The older hermetic `scratchDirSitesInSource` cases sit in a slow section. They are noted in the PR and not filed.
